purpose: Evidence-saturation discovery of English terminology and T0 paper innovation/potential-impact indicators; not an exhaustive broad-query census.
design: deterministic sequential stratified sampling with dual novelty saturation

snapshot.role: optional provenance and local indexability check; OpenAlex API is authoritative for live retrieval

sampling.target_oversampling: one stratum per frozen bootstrap target term and work type
sampling.evidence_oversampling: one stratum per frozen bootstrap evidence term and work type
sampling.reason_no_field_strata: Search domains are evidence outputs and cannot be used as a sampling stratum.

sequential_review.round_unit: next deterministic batch from every active stratum
sequential_review.phase_reset_rule: dual-zero counter resets after the formal frame freezes
novelty_endpoints: new non-redundant English canonical search-term family
additional_stop_gates: all indexable development and hidden seeds recalled
citation tracking produces no new endpoint in required rounds

claim_boundary.allowed: systematic evidence map continued to terminology-and-indicator saturation
claim_boundary.not_allowed: exhaustive census of all broad-query hits
